claims: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:50 p.m. PDT.
The launch followed a Sunday scrub.
The Falcon 9 booster landed on a drone ship in the Pacific Ocean.
Starlink 17-35 launched from Space Launch Complex 4E, Vandenberg Space Force Base, California.
Starlink 17-35 booster landing is Of Course I Still Love You drone ship.
As of April 6, 2026, SpaceX has NG-24 Mission scheduled for April 8.
As of April 6, 2026, SpaceX has Starlink Mission scheduled for April 9.
As of April 6, 2026, SpaceX has Starlink Mission scheduled for April 11.
